newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry.
There were 16,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 15,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week and 10 loads or 400 head of CME cattle.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 1,500 Year Ago - 100
Wk to Date - 16,300 Week Ago - 3,500 Year Ago - 12,900
